claimant_lives_in_uk.description: Whether the claimant lives in the UK.

children.description: A list of children the claimant is claiming for.

lives_with_claimant.description: Whether the child lives with the claimant.

in_approved_education.description: Whether the child is in approved education or training (e.g. A-levels, GCSEs, NVQ up to level 3). Only relevant for children aged 16-19.

in_extension_period.description: Whether the child (aged 16 or 17) has left education and registered with a government-sponsored careers service or the armed forces (qualifying for a 20-week extension).

upkeep_per_week.description: The amount in £ per week the claimant contributes towards the child's upkeep (food, clothes, pocket money, etc.). Only relevant if the child does not live with the claimant.

another_claimant_has_priority.description: Whether another person who also lives with the child has priority for claiming Child Benefit.

another_claimant_lives_with_child.description: Whether someone who lives with the child is already claiming Child Benefit for them.

care_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in local authority care.

care_home_24h_per_week.description: Whether the child spends at least 24 hours per week at home while in local authority care.

hospital_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in hospital or residential accommodation.

claimant_spends_on_child.description: Whether the claimant regularly spends money on the child (e.g. food, clothes, books) while the child is in hospital or residential accommodation.

is_fostered.description: Whether the child is fostered by the claimant.

council_pays_for_child.description: Whether the local council pays towards the child's accommodation or maintenance.

works_24_plus_hours.description: Whether the child works 24 or more hours per week in paid employment.

started_apprenticeship_in_england.description: Whether the child has started an apprenticeship in England.

receives_qualifying_benefits.description: Whether the child receives qualifying benefits in their own right, such as Universal Credit or Employment and Support Allowance.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Hello! I'd be happy to help you determine if you're eligible for Child Benefit. To do this properly, I'll need to gather some information about your situation and your children.

Let me start with a basic question:

**How many children do you have that you'd like me to assess for Child Benefit?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Hello! I'd like to check if I'm eligible for Child Benefit. I have one child I need to ask about.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for that context. That's helpful! Let me ask you some questions to assess your eligibility.

**What is your child's name?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: His name is Alex.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you! Now I have a few questions about Alex to determine eligibility.

**How old is Alex?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: He's 8 years old.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you. That's useful information.

**Does Alex live with you?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, he lives with me.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Good, thank you. Now I need to check a few more details about your circumstances.

**Are you responsible for Alex's upbringing and maintenance?** (In other words, do you provide for his day-to-day care and support?)

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, I am responsible for his upbringing and care.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you. That's helpful.

**What is your residency status in the UK?** (For example, are you a British citizen, settled status holder, or do you have another type of visa or residency arrangement?)

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: I'm a UK resident - I live here in the UK.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for clarifying that. To ensure I have the full picture, I need to understand your residency status more precisely for Child Benefit purposes.

**Are you a British citizen, or do you have settled status/indefinite leave to remain in the UK?** (Or if you have a different immigration status, could you let me know what that is?)

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: I'm a British citizen.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Excellent, thank you for that information.

Just to confirm one more important detail:

**Are you currently residing in the UK, and have you been a resident here for the required period?** (Child Benefit requires you to be habitually resident in the UK.)

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, I live in the UK and have been living here.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for confirming that. Let me get one final piece of information to complete the assessment.

**Is Alex in full-time education or training, or does he have any other status I should know about?** (For example, is he in school, or is there anything else relevant to his circumstances?)

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: He's 8, so he's just in primary school.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Perfect, thank you for that information. I now have all the details I need to assess your eligibility for Child Benefit for Alex.

Let me review the eligibility criteria to make my determination.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text: Based on the information you've provided and the eligibility criteria I've reviewed, I can now provide you with my assessment.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
**Good news! You are eligible for Child Benefit for Alex.**

You meet all the requirements:
- Alex is 8 years old (under 16)
- You are responsible for his upbringing and care
- Alex lives with you
- You live in the UK and are habitually resident here as a British citizen
- There are no special circumstances affecting his eligibility

You should now be able to apply for Child Benefit. If you have any further questions or if your circumstances change, you can contact the Child Benefit Office for assistance.
